what: The Metal backend's opt-in fp32 reader (--precision fp32, Engine(precision='fp32')) on a Mac mini (M4 Pro, 20-core GPU), hybrid_3d2d-seed42 on S1 (2048 x 2048 crop of the PHerc. 343 render), against villa's PyTorch on MPS, which runs float32 eager (villa autocasts on CUDA only). Parity: scripts/villa_parity.py at villa e213a1137, layer starts 21-29, both directions, overlap 0.5, Hann blend; inkrs runs through villa's adapter. Wall time: villa's whole infer command, one depth (layers 25-42), both directions, three rounds in rotating order after one warm-up each, PyTorch with PYTORCH_MPS_HIGH_WATERMARK_RATIO 0.6 and PYTORCH_MPS_LOW_WATERMARK_RATIO 0.5. Sweep: Engine.sweep over depths -4..4, both directions (18 maps), one process each
validation: Metal kernel tests at both precisions against f64: fp16 under API and shader validation, fp32 under API validation only (shader validation doubles a kernel's threadgroup memory, and the fp32 64-wide tiles' 18 KB then fail its 32 KB check)
